rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose way to describe a business or activity that makes money.

example.jyutping: ne1 mun4 saang1 ji3 gei2 jau5 cin2 zaan6 wo3

rows.note: Use this for something beneficial, serviceable, or of practical use rather than something that earns money.

example.english: This tip is profitable to remember.
example.traditional: 呢個貼士好有用，記住佢啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tip3 si6 hou2 jau5 jung6 gei3 zyu6 keoi5 laa1
